nodes.name: Webhook Historico
nodes.notes: IMPORTANTE: la autenticación se hace con una credencial nativa 'Header Auth' (nombre de header: x-n8n-secret, valor = el mismo secreto que N8N_HISTORICO_SECRET en Django). Esto evita depender de $env dentro de expresiones, que muchas instancias de n8n bloquean por defecto (N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE).

parameters.sqlQuery:
WITH hoy AS (
  SELECT AVG(valor) AS valor
  FROM `proyecto-bi-488218.datos_clima.snapshots_historicos`
  WHERE sector = @sector AND variable = @variable
    AND ABS(lat - SAFE_CAST(@lat AS FLOAT64)) < 0.05
    AND ABS(lon - SAFE_CAST(@lon AS FLOAT64)) < 0.05
    AND DATE(timestamp) = CURRENT_DATE()
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp) = EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
),
historico AS (
  SELECT AVG(valor) AS promedio, STDDEV(valor) AS desviacion, COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(timestamp)) AS n_dias
  FROM `proyecto-bi-488218.datos_clima.snapshots_historicos`
  WHERE sector = @sector AND variable = @variable
    AND ABS(lat - SAFE_CAST(@lat AS FLOAT64)) < 0.05
    AND ABS(lon - SAFE_CAST(@lon AS FLOAT64)) < 0.05
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp) = EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
    AND DATE(timestamp) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 5 WEEK) AND DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
),
semanas AS (
  SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', DATE_TRUNC(DATE(timestamp), WEEK(MONDAY))) AS semana, AVG(valor) AS valor
  FROM `proyecto-bi-488218.datos_clima.snapshots_historicos`
  WHERE sector = @sector AND variable = @variable
    AND ABS(lat - SAFE_CAST(@lat AS FLOAT64)) < 0.05
    AND ABS(lon - SAFE_CAST(@lon AS FLOAT64)) < 0.05
    AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM timestamp) = EXTRACT(HOUR FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
    AND DATE(timestamp) BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 5 WEEK) AND CURRENT_DATE()
  GROUP BY semana
  ORDER BY semana
)
SELECT
  (SELECT valor FROM hoy) AS hoy_valor,
  (SELECT promedio FROM historico) AS promedio_historico,
  (SELECT desviacion FROM historico) AS desviacion,
  (SELECT n_dias FROM historico) AS n_dias,
  ARRAY(SELECT AS STRUCT semana, valor FROM semanas) AS serie_semanas;
